initial.prompt:
Create a production-quality 4-DIRECTION WALK CYCLE of MIRA, the SAME original adult woman mechanic in the two reference images. Preserve the exact warm brown high ponytail, teal work jacket, cream high-neck shirt, charcoal shorts, brown work boots and gloves, small brass tool belt. Target FOUR HEADS TALL as in the larger walking reference: head 25 percent of total standing height, torso and pelvis 25 percent, legs and boots 50 percent. Do not compress into a 2-head chibi. Clear square pixel clusters, restrained 3 shades per material, 1 logical pixel dark outline. NO soft painted gradients, no hair micro-detail, no individual strand rendering. Cute capable adult game sprite, same character in every frame.
CANVAS: exactly 1536x1024 landscape. Completely uniform flat light cream #EEEAE0 background, NO gradient, NO texture, NO shadow. NO text, lines, labels, large portrait or props. Exactly FOUR ROWS by EIGHT COLUMNS = 32 full-body sprites. Invisible cells 192x256; sprite centered on cell x=96, feet baseline y=236 inside EVERY cell; height about 204 pixels. Leave clean separation and padding. Same physical scale in ALL rows and columns; crouch only 1-2 pixels during walk, head/torso widths never vary.
ALL sprites are seen from a game camera elevated 35 degrees. Use THREE-QUARTER diagonal body views, NEVER straight front, straight back or pure side profile.
ROW 1: SOUTHWEST / front-left: face and chest visible, nose toward lower left, both eyes but far eye narrower.
ROW 2: NORTHWEST / back-left: back of head, back of teal jacket, ponytail and left shoulder visible; face mostly hidden, nose barely left contour.
ROW 3: NORTHEAST / back-right: back of head, back of teal jacket, ponytail and right shoulder visible; face mostly hidden, nose barely right contour.
ROW 4: SOUTHEAST / front-right: face and chest visible, nose toward lower right, both eyes but far eye narrower.
WITHIN EVERY ROW the eight poses are one chronological smooth grounded WALK cycle, all maintaining that row's facing. The order left to right is: (1) left foot contact forward, right foot trailing; (2) left knee slight flex weight transfer, feet getting closer; (3) left leg supporting directly under pelvis, right knee BENT with boot LIFTED passing near the calf, legs almost together; (4) left heel rising, right thigh forward with modest bent knee; (5) right foot contact forward, left foot trailing, opposite arm positions; (6) right knee flex weight transfer; (7) right leg supporting, left boot lifted passing close to calf, legs almost together; (8) right heel rising, left thigh forward to return to pose 1. Columns 3 and 7 MUST have a narrow overlapping leg silhouette. Columns 1 and 5 MUST have a wider contact silhouette with a clearly opposite leg forward. Do not repeat wide open legs in all columns. No high-knee marching: raised knee never reaches belt level. Hands and arms swing modestly opposite the legs. Ponytail trails gently 1-2 pixels, attached at the SAME point.
Pixel artist animation sheet: subtle bob, believable alternating weight, closed passing poses, clean shoulder/hip registration. Each foot-ground line anchored, no body sliding in its cell. Consistent outfit and face, not individually redesigned illustrations. No mirrored lettering, no extra weapons. This one image is ONLY 32 walking cels of Mira.

revision.prompt:
Edit this exact Mira character walking sheet into a correct, production-quality 4-direction walking animation CONTACT SHEET. Preserve this character's identity, the approximately FOUR HEADS TALL proportions, brown high ponytail, teal short work jacket, cream shirt, leather utility belt, charcoal shorts, brown gloves, knee-high dark socks and brown boots. Important: a full cycle must ALTERNATE THE TWO LEGS; the attached sheet incorrectly repeats the SAME LEADING LEG. Correct it with anatomical opposite leg contacts. Keep 8 columns and 4 rows, 1536 by 1024. Absolutely NO added poses, labels, text, panels, shadows, or decoration. Uniform flat background #eeeae0 with no gradients or paper texture. Pixel-art aesthetic with hard pixel clusters, no soft painted rendering. Narrow dark brown outline, restrained 3-tone shading.
Row 1: front-left diagonal SW. Row 2: back-left diagonal NW. Row 3: back-right diagonal NE. Row 4: front-right diagonal SE. Each row is one direction, a looping WALK cycle. Same camera angle and same figure size in all 32 cels. Feet share a stable floor baseline within each row, head naturally bobs only slightly. Natural walking, low feet, not running/marching.
CRUCIAL 8 PHASES LEFT TO RIGHT IN EACH ROW:
1: NEAR leg extends FORWARD, FAR leg extends BACK; far arm forward.
2: Near foot planted forward under loading body, FAR knee begins to swing forward.
3: Near leg vertical planted under hip, FAR leg bent and passing beside planted leg.
4: FAR knee extends forward, near heel lifts behind hip.
5: FAR leg extends FORWARD, NEAR leg extends BACK; near arm forward. This MUST BE VISUALLY DIFFERENT from pose 1, not a repeat or translation.
6: Far foot planted under loading body, NEAR knee begins to swing forward.
7: Far leg vertical planted under hip, NEAR leg bent and passing beside planted leg.
8: NEAR knee extends forward, far heel lifts behind hip, transitions seamlessly to phase 1.
Think like an experienced sprite animator: define two different legs via overlap at the shorts and knees. Arms reciprocate the legs. Hair subtly follows. Center hips consistently in each cell so clipping each sprite does not make it jitter. Do not mirror entire characters to imply the opposite stride. Redraw actual limb articulations.
